blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Government troops recovered a squad automatic rifle, an improvised explosive device (IED), and ammunition following a brief armed encounter with suspected remnants of the New People’s Army (NPA) in Barangay Capotuan, Las Navas, Northern Samar, on Sunday, the military said. The 8th Infantry Division (8ID), based in Catbalogan City, Samar, reported that the encounter occurred early Sunday morning as government troops were conducting a joint focused military operation against an armed group believed to be remnants of the NPA’s Sub-Regional Committee Emporium.
